title: File:Youth Center in Kramatorsk after Russian attack, 2026-09-01 (01).jpg
desc: Youth Center in Kramatorsk (Donetsk region) after Russian bombing on 1 September 2026 (1, 2).

title: File:Church in Kramatorsk after Russian attack, 2026-09-22 (13).jpg
desc: Church of the Nativity of Saint John the Baptist (of Moscow Patriarchate) in Kramatorsk after Russian strike on the city with drones and 5 guided air-dropped bomb on 22 September 2026. Besides the church, 10 apartment buildings and 54 private houses, a bank, a shop and cars were damaged in the city.
